players.product: BlueBird Block 2 direct-to-cell satellites (custom AST5000 ASIC) and MNO gateway equipment

quarterly_data.signal: AST 10-K: AST plans noncontinuous SpaceMobile Service in targeted markets with a total of 25 BlueBird satellites (five Block 1 and 20 Block 2) and will introduce its own AST5000 ASIC chip in the Block 2 BB satellites; products revenue is mainly gateway equipment, software and related services sold to MNOs.
AST 10-K: definitive commercial agreements with AT&T, Verizon, STC and Vodafone plus approximately 50 preliminary agreements and understandings with other MNOs; revenue-sharing model with MNOs.

AST 10-K: U.S. government work - a contract with the U.S. Space Development Agency through a prime contractor with total expected revenue of $43.0 million for testing services on the initial BB satellites, a direct SDA agreement for the Europa Track 2 commercial solutions program worth approximately $30.0 million, and a SHIELD IDIQ award under the Missile Defense Agency's multi-award framework.
AST 10-K: under the Ligado Transaction (definitive agreements of March 22, 2025 for usage rights to mid-band spectrum) AST agreed to pay Ligado consideration totaling $550.0 million in cash.

AST 10-K: contractual commitments of approximately $489.1 million as of December 31, 2025, primarily for R&D programs, operational services, capital improvements and procurement of BB satellite components.
